turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I am almost out of my albuterol inhaler.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: How often are you using it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About twice a week, usually before I mow the lawn.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any night time waking from wheezing?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I will refill the albuterol inhaler with two refills.
